This attempt's diff (commits 9075390 and a290ecb, checked against main) needed no fixes, so I committed nothing:
- `src/game.js:65`: the new `click(state, col, row)` does what its comment says. It restarts a finished round and places a lantern during play. `src/main.js` calls it, so the old restart branch in `main.js` is gone.
- `test/game-over.test.js:105`: the click test can fail. A tower must actually be placed while playing, and a lost game must restart to `'playing'` with no towers and its own lives option (2), not the default.
- `src/render.js:168`: the three `quadraticCurveTo` scallops end at (-12, 12), the hem's start point, so the path closes as the comment describes. The new test in `test/render.test.js:165` would have failed on the old zig-zag, which drew no `quadraticCurveTo`.
- Scope: the diff stays inside the six paths on the triage's `touches:` list.

One thing beyond this attempt's two commits: `origin/print/line-factory-baked-demo-ov2` is behind. The range the pass asks for also pulls in print a8h's commits, which `main` already has (#21). Diffed against `main` instead, the diff covers only the six paths in this print's `touches:` list plus its own chain files under `docs/changes/line-factory-baked-demo-ov2`.
